entries.source: A full-scale theme park and waterpark experience in Belek, with family attractions, thrill rides and seasonal entertainment.
entries.translation: A full-scale theme park and waterpark experience in Belek, with family attractions, thrill rides and seasonal entertainment.

entries.source: Choose a daytime Theme Park visit or an evening Shopping Avenue experience with organized round-trip transfer from Alanya. Attraction availability and event schedules may change by date and season.
entries.translation: Choose a daytime Theme Park visit or an evening Shopping Avenue experience with organized round-trip transfer from Alanya. Attraction availability and event schedules may change by date and season.

entries.source: The Land of Legends in Belek is much more than a traditional amusement park. It brings together themed entertainment lands, water attractions, family zones, roller coasters, character experiences, live shows, restaurants and Shopping Avenue in one large resort-style destination.
entries.translation: The Land of Legends in Belek is much more than a traditional amusement park. It brings together themed entertainment lands, water attractions, family zones, roller coasters, character experiences, live shows, restaurants and Shopping Avenue in one large resort-style destination.

entries.source: Families with children can explore colourful areas inspired by Nickelodeon characters, PAW Patrol, SpongeBob, Masha and the Bear and other themed worlds. At the same time, teenagers and adults can choose faster rides, major roller coasters, high-energy slides and adrenaline attractions.
entries.translation: Families with children can explore colourful areas inspired by Nickelodeon characters, PAW Patrol, SpongeBob, Masha and the Bear and other themed worlds. At the same time, teenagers and adults can choose faster rides, major roller coasters, high-energy slides and adrenaline attractions.

entries.source: Water entertainment is spread across areas such as Aqua Land, Tropic Lagoon and other seasonal water zones, with pools, slides, family experiences and more intense attractions. Not every attraction is suitable for every guest: height, age, weight and safety restrictions apply individually.
entries.translation: Water entertainment is spread across areas such as Aqua Land, Tropic Lagoon and other seasonal water zones, with pools, slides, family experiences and more intense attractions. Not every attraction is suitable for every guest: height, age, weight and safety restrictions apply individually.

entries.source: In the evening, Shopping Avenue becomes a separate entertainment setting with illuminated canals, restaurants, shops, fountain effects and seasonal live events. The current program may include the Musical Boat Parade, character appearances, music, light effects and stage performances.
entries.translation: In the evening, Shopping Avenue becomes a separate entertainment setting with illuminated canals, restaurants, shops, fountain effects and seasonal live events. The current program may include the Musical Boat Parade, character appearances, music, light effects and stage performances.

entries.source: Is the Theme Park ticket included?
entries.translation: Is the Theme Park ticket included?

entries.source: Yes, the Theme Park entrance ticket is included in the Day Tour and in our exclusive Day + Night package. The Night Tour is an evening Shopping Avenue transfer and does not include daytime Theme Park access.
entries.translation: Yes, the Theme Park entrance ticket is included in the Day Tour and in our exclusive Day + Night package. The Night Tour is an evening Shopping Avenue transfer and does not include daytime Theme Park access.

entries.source: What is the exclusive Day + Night package?
entries.translation: What is the exclusive Day + Night package?

entries.source: It is a combined product created by ALANYA TOUR ORGANIZATIONS. It includes the daytime Theme Park visit, the evening Shopping Avenue and scheduled night entertainment, and the organized return transfer to Alanya for €95 per adult and €75 per child.
entries.translation: It is a combined product created by ALANYA TOUR ORGANIZATIONS. It includes the daytime Theme Park visit, the evening Shopping Avenue and scheduled night entertainment, and the organized return transfer to Alanya for €95 per adult and €75 per child.

entries.source: No fixed performance should be guaranteed before checking the selected date. Events, times and formats may change due to the official program, weather or operational decisions.
entries.translation: No fixed performance should be guaranteed before checking the selected date. Events, times and formats may change due to the official program, weather or operational decisions.

entries.source: Are all rides and water attractions open?
entries.translation: Are all rides and water attractions open?

entries.source: Only operating attractions are available. Some rides, pools or water areas may close because of season, weather, maintenance, age or height restrictions.
entries.translation: Only operating attractions are available. Some rides, pools or water areas may close because of season, weather, maintenance, age or height restrictions.

entries.source: What is not included in the Day Tour ticket?
entries.translation: What is not included in the Day Tour ticket?

entries.source: Food, drinks, lockers, Fast Track, Street Games, Surf, Dolphin Land activities, photo services, cabanas and other separately paid experiences are not included unless explicitly stated.
entries.translation: Food, drinks, lockers, Fast Track, Street Games, Surf, Dolphin Land activities, photo services, cabanas and other separately paid experiences are not included unless explicitly stated.

entries.source: Yes. The park may request an ID or passport to verify infant and child ages. Guests under 12 must enter with an adult aged 18 or over.
entries.translation: Yes. The park may request an ID or passport to verify infant and child ages. Guests under 12 must enter with an adult aged 18 or over.

entries.source: When will I receive the pickup time?

entries.source: Your exact pickup time is confirmed after booking according to your hotel or apartment location and the selected date.

entries.source: Write us on WhatsApp to check the current operating date, pickup time and the correct option: Theme Park Day Tour, Shopping Avenue Night Tour or our exclusive Day + Night package.
entries.translation: Write us on WhatsApp to check the current operating date, pickup time and the correct option: Theme Park Day Tour, Shopping Avenue Night Tour or our exclusive Day + Night package.

entries.source: Outside food and alcoholic or non-alcoholic drinks, including water, are not permitted inside the Theme Park. Bags may be checked at the entrance.
entries.translation: Outside food and alcoholic or non-alcoholic drinks, including water, are not permitted inside the Theme Park. Bags may be checked at the entrance.

entries.source: Babies and children under 3 must wear waterproof swim diapers in pool areas. Standard diapers are not suitable.
entries.translation: Babies and children under 3 must wear waterproof swim diapers in pool areas. Standard diapers are not suitable.

entries.source: Guests under 12 may enter and use the park only when accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over.
entries.translation: Guests under 12 may enter and use the park only when accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over.

entries.source: Each ride and slide has its own health, height, weight, age and accompaniment requirements. Entry is allowed only when all posted safety conditions are met.
entries.translation: Each ride and slide has its own health, height, weight, age and accompaniment requirements. Entry is allowed only when all posted safety conditions are met.

entries.source: Guests must follow the information signs and staff instructions at every attraction. Rules and operating conditions may be changed by The Land of Legends.
